nodes.body: This cannot be merged until #3642 and #3766 are merged and this is rebased upon

the gated kernels with LUT and register-resident approach is also added in this PR in CUDA,. However I would like to move it to CuteDSL. However, @kainzhong  is already working on it, so this draft will temporarily have the CUDA version, but will rebase don kaining's CuteDSL version of the gated kernel to add the LUT once that PR is up. This will make this PR also waiting for that.

If not, I will drop support for LUT in gateed kernel entirely in this PR and make that a follow up PR

@@ -342,6 +342,18 @@ Kernel Configuration
    :Default: ``0``
    :Description: Disable NVRTC (CUDA Runtime Compilation) support. When set to ``1``, runtime kernel compilation is disabled. Existing transpose operations select their static fallback automatically. NVFP4 4over6 quantization, fused softmax, and normalization paths require their corresponding ``NVTE_BUILD_LEGACY_STATIC_NVFP4``, ``NVTE_BUILD_LEGACY_STATIC_FUSED_SOFTMAX``, or ``NVTE_BUILD_LEGACY_STATIC_NORM`` CMake option to have been enabled when the library was built; otherwise no static fallback is available.
 
+.. envvar:: NVTE_ACTIVATION_TABLE
+
+   :Type: ``int`` (0 or 1)
+   :Default: ``0``
+   :Description: Experimental. When set to ``1``, read GeLU, SiLU and their derivatives from lookup tables when BF16 inputs are quantized to MXFP8. Each table is built on its first use and kept, once per device and process (under 64 KB per device in total), outside the framework's memory allocator. Results match the computed activations, except that GeLU and SiLU of ``-inf`` give ``-0`` instead of NaN, and derivatives of inputs with ``|x| < 2^-12`` (GeLU) or ``|x| < 2^-9`` (SiLU) are within 1 ulp (GeLU) or 2 ulp (SiLU) of the computed ones. When set to ``0``, the activations are computed. Read on every call.
+
+.. envvar:: NVTE_ACTIVATION_TABLE_EXACT_DSILU
+
+   :Type: ``int`` (0 or 1)
+   :Default: ``0``
+   :Description: Experimental. Choose the SiLU-derivative lookup table (see :envvar:`NVTE_ACTIVATION_TABLE`). By default the 16 KB table covers ``|x| >= 2^-9`` and smaller inputs use the linear term ``0.5 + x/2``, which is within 2 ulp of the computed derivative. When set to ``1``, a 32 KB table covers ``|x| >= 2^-25``, and the derivative matches the computed one for every input. Read once per process, when the table is built.
+
 .. envvar:: NVTE_USE_CUTLASS_GROUPED_GEMM
 
    :Type: ``int`` (0 or 1)

+    flags = (True, q_layout.has_colwise, False, is_bwd)
+    major, minor = device_compute_capability()

+        f"{FP8_TO_KEY[fp8_dtype]}_"
+        + "_".join("1" if f else "0" for f in flags)

+def run_gated_test_case(
+    act_type, act_desc, act_kwargs, is_bwd, shape, q_layout, in_dtype, fp8_dtype
+):
+    """Assert the CuTeDSL and CUDA backends produce bit-identical gated activation outputs.
+    shape is (M, N): the gated input is (M, 2, N), [act | gate] along axis -2.
+    """
+    M, N = shape
+    # generate_inputs returns (M, N) and (M, 1, N) draws; stack them into the (M, 2, N) input
+    act, gate = generate_inputs(M, N, in_dtype)
+    x = jnp.concatenate([jnp.expand_dims(act, axis=-2), gate], axis=-2)
+    grad, _ = generate_inputs(M, N, in_dtype, seed=1)
+    act_params = ActivationParams.create(act_type, **act_kwargs)
+
+    def run():
+        quantizer = QuantizerFactory.create(
+            scaling_mode=ScalingMode.MXFP8_1D_SCALING, q_dtype=fp8_dtype, q_layout=q_layout

+            )
+        else:
+            out = tex.act_lu(x, act_type, quantizer=quantizer, act_params=act_params)
+        return extract_quantized_output(out, None)[0]
+
+    set_cutedsl_backend(False)
+    cuda_output = run()
+    set_cutedsl_backend(True)
+    try:
+        cutedsl_output = run()
+    finally:
+        set_cutedsl_backend(False)

+        f"{DTYPE_TO_STR[in_dtype]}/{FP8_TO_STR[fp8_dtype]}"
+    )
+    for name, cuda_bytes in cuda_output.items():

+    """The forward activation a kernel computes: with a table, what the table holds."""
+    op = SUPPORTED_ACTIVATIONS[activation]
+    return op if activation_table == "none" else forward_table_spec(op)
+
+
+def dactivation_op(activation: str, activation_table: str):
+    """The activation derivative a kernel computes: with a table, what the table holds."""
+    dop = SUPPORTED_DACTIVATIONS[activation]
+    if activation_table == "none":
+        return dop
+    return derivative_table_spec(dop, activation, activation_table)
+
+
+# Gated activations of gated_mxfp8.cuh, as (ActOP, DActOP) ports of the math.h functions the
+# CUDA dispatcher instantiates them with. swiglu and clamped_swiglu backward, and situglu in
+# both directions, do not go through this table: like the CUDA kernel they take a special path.
+GATED_ACTIVATIONS = {
+    "geglu": (act_gelu, dact_dgelu),
+    "qgeglu": (act_qgelu, dact_dqgelu),
+    "reglu": (act_relu, dact_drelu),
+    "sreglu": (act_srelu, dact_dsrelu),
+    "glu": (act_sigmoid, dact_dsigmoid),
+    "swiglu": (act_silu, None),
+    "clamped_swiglu": (None, None),
+    "situglu": (None, None),
+}
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def derive_swizzled_scale_layout(
+    M: Int32,
+    N: Int32,
+    ROWWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    COLWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+):
+    """Derive the swizzled layout for the rowwise and colwise scale tensors."""
+    num_scale_cols = cute.ceil_div(N, MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE)
+    num_scale_rows = cute.ceil_div(M, MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE)
+
+    num_tiles_M = cute.ceil_div(M, 128)
+    num_tiles_SC = cute.ceil_div(num_scale_cols, 4)
+    num_tiles_SR = cute.ceil_div(num_scale_rows, 4)
+    num_tiles_N = cute.ceil_div(N, 128)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(ROWWISE):
+        mS_row = cute.make_tensor(
+            mS_row.iterator,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                ((32, 4, num_tiles_M), (4, num_tiles_SC)),
+                stride=((16, 4, num_tiles_SC * 512), (1, 512)),
+            ),
+        )
+    if cutlass.const_expr(COLWISE):
+        mS_col = cute.make_tensor(
+            mS_col.iterator,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                ((4, num_tiles_SR), (32, 4, num_tiles_N)),
+                stride=((1, 512), (16, 4, num_tiles_SR * 512)),
+            ),
+        )
+    return mS_row, mS_col
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def noop_flag_is_set(mNoop: cute.Pointer) -> Boolean:
+    """Whether the cast_noop flag says this quantization is a no-op and must be skipped.
+
+    mNoop is a pointer rather than a tensor so that one compiled kernel serves both a present and
+    an absent flag, hence the address is checked before it is dereferenced, exactly like the CUDA
+    C++ kernel's `noop != nullptr && noop[0] == 1.0f`. The two checks cannot be joined with `and`,
+    which the DSL lowers to a non-short-circuiting op that would load from the null pointer.
+    """
+    flag_is_set = Boolean(False)
+    if mNoop.toint() != Int64(0):
+        flag_is_set = cute.make_tensor(mNoop, cute.make_layout((1,)))[0] == Float32(1.0)
+    return flag_is_set
+
+
+class MXFP8QuantizeConfig:
+    """Configs for the compiled CuTeDSL kernel. These will be fixed once the kernel is compiled and
+    they will behave as const expressions.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dtype: str,
+        fp8_dtype: str,
+        rowwise: bool,
+        colwise: bool,
+        with_gemm_swizzled_scales: bool,
+        with_amax: bool,
+        with_dbias: bool = False,
+        with_dact: bool = False,
+        with_act: bool = False,
+        use_2d_quantization: bool = False,
+        activation: Optional[str] = None,
+        activation_table: str = "none",
+    ):
+        if use_2d_quantization:
+            raise ValueError("2D block scaling is not implemented by the CuTeDSL MXFP8 kernels")
+        if dtype is None or dtype not in ("Float32", "Float16", "BFloat16"):
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown input dtype {dtype!r}; expected Float32|Float16|BFloat16")
+        self.DTYPE = str_to_cutlass_dtype(dtype)
+        self.DTYPE_STR = dtype  # readable input-dtype token, for __str__
+        if fp8_dtype not in ("Float8E4M3", "Float8E5M2"):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"unknown FP8 dtype {fp8_dtype!r}; expected 'Float8E4M3' or 'Float8E5M2'"
+            )
+        self.FP8_DTYPE = str_to_cutlass_dtype(fp8_dtype)
+        self.FP8_DTYPE_STR = fp8_dtype  # readable token, for __str__
+        self.ROWWISE = rowwise
+        self.COLWISE = colwise
+        if not (rowwise or colwise):
+            raise ValueError("at least one of rowwise or colwise must be true")
+        self.WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES = with_gemm_swizzled_scales
+        self.WITH_AMAX = with_amax
+        if not with_dact and not with_act:
+            if activation == "none":
+                self.ACTIVATION = None
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "activation must be none when with_dact and with_act are both False"
+                )
+        else:
+            if with_dact and with_act:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "with_dact and with_act cannot be true at the same time since they are used for"
+                    " different paths (bwd vs fwd)"
+                )
+            if with_dact:
+                if activation in SUPPORTED_DACTIVATIONS:
+                    self.ACTIVATION = activation
+                else:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"unknown activation {activation!r} for with_dact=True; expected one of"
+                        f" {sorted(SUPPORTED_DACTIVATIONS)}"
+                    )
+            elif with_act:
+                if activation in SUPPORTED_ACTIVATIONS:
+                    self.ACTIVATION = activation
+                else:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"unknown activation {activation!r} for with_act=True; expected one of"
+                        f" {sorted(SUPPORTED_ACTIVATIONS)}"
+                    )
+        self.WITH_DACT = with_dact
+        self.WITH_ACT = with_act
+        # With a table, BF16 activations follow the table specification: the register-resident
+        # kernel reads the table, the others compute what it holds.
+        if activation_table not in ACTIVATION_TABLE_LAYOUTS:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"unknown activation table {activation_table!r}; expected one of"
+                f" {ACTIVATION_TABLE_LAYOUTS}"
+            )
+        if activation_table != "none" and (
+            dtype != "BFloat16"
+            or self.ACTIVATION not in ACTIVATIONS_WITH_TABLE
+            or (activation_table == "exact" and self.ACTIVATION != "dsilu")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"no {activation_table!r} activation table for {self.ACTIVATION!r} with {dtype}"
+            )
+        self.ACTIVATION_TABLE = activation_table
+        # dbias is the column reduction of the (post-act/dact) element. With colwise
+        # output each thread owns a full column (trivial reduction); rowwise-only
+        # uses a cross-thread smem reduction over THREADS_Y. Both mirror the CUDA
+        # kernel's COLWISE_SCALING / rowwise dbias branches.
+        self.WITH_DBIAS = with_dbias
+        self.MAX_NORM_RCP = (
+            FP8E4M3_MAX_NORM_RCP if fp8_dtype == "Float8E4M3" else FP8E5M2_MAX_NORM_RCP
+        )
+
+    def __str__(self):
+        return (
+            f"MXFP8QuantizeConfig(dtype={self.DTYPE_STR}, fp8_dtype={self.FP8_DTYPE_STR}, "
+            f"rowwise={self.ROWWISE}, colwise={self.COLWISE}, "
+            f"swizzled={self.WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES}, with_amax={self.WITH_AMAX}, "
+            f"with_dbias={self.WITH_DBIAS}, with_dact={self.WITH_DACT}, "
+            f"with_act={self.WITH_ACT}, activation={self.ACTIVATION}, "
+            f"activation_table={self.ACTIVATION_TABLE})"
+        )
+
+    __repr__ = __str__
+
+    def is_plain_cast(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether cfg is a plain cast: no amax, dbias or (d)activation fused in."""
+        return not (self.WITH_AMAX or self.WITH_DBIAS or self.WITH_DACT or self.WITH_ACT)
+
+    def compile(self):
+        """
+        Return the compiled CuTeDSL function object for the given MXFP8 quantization config.
+        """
+
+        kernel_obj = MXFP8QuantizeEntry(self)
+        sym_M = cute.sym_int32()
+        sym_N = cute.sym_int32(divisibility=SYM_N_DIVISIBILITY)
+        in_shape = out_shape = (sym_M, sym_N)
+        # TE allocates scale tensors at a padded shape (see
+        # MXFP8Quantizer::get_scale_shape in transformer_engine/pytorch/csrc):
+        #   rowwise:    (roundup(M, 128),           roundup(ceildiv(N, 32), 4))
+        #   columnwise: (roundup(ceildiv(M, 32), 4), roundup(N, 128))
+        # These padded extents are NOT M/N (and SymInt has no `//`/`+`), so give the
+        # scales their own fresh syms carrying the divisibility the padding
+        # guarantees (rowwise: 128 x 4; colwise: 4 x 128).
+        scale_rowwise_shape = (cute.sym_int32(divisibility=128), cute.sym_int32(divisibility=4))
+        scale_colwise_shape = (cute.sym_int32(divisibility=4), cute.sym_int32(divisibility=128))
+        ws_shape = (cute.sym_int32(), sym_N)  # (blocks_Y, N); N ties to input N
+        # Native FP8/E8M0 dtypes at the FFI boundary (matches the DLPack dtype the C++
+        # bridge sends).
+        out_dtype = self.FP8_DTYPE
+        scale_dtype = cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU
+
+        in_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+            self.DTYPE,
+            in_shape,
+            stride_order=(1, 0),
+            memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+            assumed_align=16,
+        )
+        out_row_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                out_dtype,
+                out_shape,
+                stride_order=(1, 0),
+                memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=16,
+            )
+            if self.ROWWISE
+            else None
+        )
+        scale_row_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                scale_dtype,
+                scale_rowwise_shape,
+                stride_order=(1, 0),
+                memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=4,
+            )
+            if self.ROWWISE
+            else None
+        )
+        out_col_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                out_dtype,
+                out_shape,
+                stride_order=(1, 0),
+                memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=16,
+            )
+            if self.COLWISE
+            else None
+        )
+        scale_col_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                scale_dtype,
+                scale_colwise_shape,
+                stride_order=(1, 0),
+                memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=4,
+            )
+            if self.COLWISE
+            else None
+        )
+        amax_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                Float32, (1,), stride_order=(0,), memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=4
+            )
+            if self.WITH_AMAX
+            else None
+        )
+        # The cast-noop flag is an always-present f32 pointer instead of an optional tensor, so that
+        # the same compiled kernel serves both an absent and a present flag (see noop_flag_is_set).
+        # The null address here is only a compile-time placeholder for the pointer the C++ dispatcher
+        # passes at launch.
+        noop_fake = cute.runtime.nullptr(Float32, mem_space=cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=4)
+        act_input_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                self.DTYPE,
+                in_shape,
+                stride_order=(1, 0),
+                memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=16,
+            )
+            if self.WITH_DACT
+            else None
+        )
+        # Like the noop flag, the activation table is an always-present pointer, null without a
+        # table.
+        act_table_fake = cute.runtime.nullptr(
+            cutlass.Uint8, mem_space=cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16
+        )
+        workspace_fake = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                Float32,
+                ws_shape,
+                stride_order=(1, 0),
+                memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=4,
+            )
+            if self.WITH_DBIAS
+            else None
+        )
+
+        compiled = cute.compile(
+            kernel_obj,
+            in_fake,  # mX
+            out_row_fake,
+            scale_row_fake,  # mO_row, mS_row
+            out_col_fake,
+            scale_col_fake,  # mO_col, mS_col
+            amax_fake,  # mAmax
+            noop_fake,  # mNoop (pointer to the cast_noop flag, may be null at launch)
+            act_input_fake,  # mDActInput (activation input, dact only)
+            workspace_fake,  # mWorkspace(backward slot, unused)
+            act_table_fake,  # mActTable (activation table, may be null at launch)
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_stream(),  # stream (compiled as an explicit tvm-ffi
+            # "handle" arg; C++ passes the CUDA stream
+            # as void*)
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )
+        return compiled
+
+
+def _fake_gmem_tensor(dtype, shape, align):
+    """Row-major fake gmem tensor for cute.compile."""
+    return cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+        dtype,
+        shape,
+        stride_order=tuple(reversed(range(len(shape)))),
+        memspace=cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+        assumed_align=align,
+    )
+

+class MXFP8GatedQuantizeConfig(MXFP8QuantizeConfig):
+    """Compile-time config of gated_mxfp8.cuh's port: a plain MXFP8 cast config plus the gated op."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dtype: str,
+        fp8_dtype: str,
+        rowwise: bool,
+        colwise: bool,
+        with_gemm_swizzled_scales: bool,
+        is_bwd: bool,
+        activation: str,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(
+            dtype=dtype,
+            fp8_dtype=fp8_dtype,
+            rowwise=rowwise,
+            colwise=colwise,
+            with_gemm_swizzled_scales=with_gemm_swizzled_scales,
+            with_amax=False,
+            activation="none",
+        )
+        if activation not in GATED_ACTIVATIONS:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"unknown gated activation {activation!r}; expected one of"
+                f" {sorted(GATED_ACTIVATIONS)}"
+            )
+        if is_bwd and with_gemm_swizzled_scales:
+            # TODO(kainingz): technically this is supported but I need to come up with a less disgusting way
+            # to implement it in CuTe
+            raise ValueError("backward gated activations with GEMM-swizzled scales")
+        self.IS_BWD = is_bwd
+        self.GATED_ACTIVATION = activation
+
+    def __str__(self):
+        return (
+            f"MXFP8GatedQuantizeConfig(dtype={self.DTYPE_STR}, fp8_dtype={self.FP8_DTYPE_STR}, "
+            f"rowwise={self.ROWWISE}, colwise={self.COLWISE}, "
+            f"swizzled={self.WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES}, is_bwd={self.IS_BWD}, "
+            f"activation={self.GATED_ACTIVATION})"
+        )
+
+    __repr__ = __str__
+
+    def compile(self):
+        """Return the compiled CuTeDSL function object for this config."""
+        # The kernel module imports this one
+        # pylint: disable-next=import-outside-toplevel
+
+        sym_M = cute.sym_int32()
+        # The C++ dispatcher requires N % 32 == 0, like the CUDA kernel.
+        sym_N = cute.sym_int32(divisibility=32)
+        sym_2N = cute.sym_int32(divisibility=64)
+        out_cols = sym_2N if self.IS_BWD else sym_N
+        # Padded scale shapes, see MXFP8QuantizeConfig.compile
+        scale_rowwise_shape = (cute.sym_int32(divisibility=128), cute.sym_int32(divisibility=4))
+        scale_colwise_shape = (cute.sym_int32(divisibility=4), cute.sym_int32(divisibility=128))
+        # Only the activation's own params are runtime arguments; the others are compiled as None
+        # and the C++ launcher passes None for them.
+        clamped = self.GATED_ACTIVATION == "clamped_swiglu"
+        situ = self.GATED_ACTIVATION == "situglu"
+        params = [Float32(0.0) if clamped else None] * 3  # limit, alpha, glu_linear_offset
+        params += [Float32(0.0) if situ else None] * 2  # beta1, beta2
+        return cute.compile(
+            MXFP8GatedQuantizeEntry(self),
+            _fake_gmem_tensor(self.DTYPE, (sym_M, sym_2N), 16),  # mGatedInput
+            _fake_gmem_tensor(self.DTYPE, (sym_M, sym_N), 16) if self.IS_BWD else None,  # mGrad
+            # mO_row, mS_row
+            _fake_gmem_tensor(self.FP8_DTYPE, (sym_M, out_cols), 16) if self.ROWWISE else None,
+            (
+                _fake_gmem_tensor(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, scale_rowwise_shape, 4)
+                if self.ROWWISE
+                else None
+            ),
+            # mO_col, mS_col
+            _fake_gmem_tensor(self.FP8_DTYPE, (sym_M, out_cols), 16) if self.COLWISE else None,
+            (
+                _fake_gmem_tensor(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, scale_colwise_shape, 4)
+                if self.COLWISE
+                else None
+            ),
+            *params,
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_stream(),
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )
+

+class MXFP8GatedQuantizeEntry:
+    """Select the gated MXFP8 kernel: the register-resident one where it applies, otherwise the
+    shared-memory port of gated_mxfp8.cuh."""
+
+    def __init__(self, cfg: MXFP8GatedQuantizeConfig):
+        # The kernel modules import this one.
+        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_gated_g2s import MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2SKernel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_gated_g2r_bidim import MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2RKernel
+
+        # pylint: enable=import-outside-toplevel
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        self.g2s_kernel = MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2SKernel(cfg)
+        self.g2r_kernel = (
+            MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2RKernel(cfg) if MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2RKernel.supports(cfg) else None
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mGatedInput: cute.Tensor,
+        mGrad: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        limit: Optional[Float32],
+        alpha: Optional[Float32],
+        glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],
+        beta1: Optional[Float32],
+        beta2: Optional[Float32],
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ):
+        args = (
+            mGatedInput,
+            mGrad,
+            mO_row,
+            mS_row,
+            mO_col,
+            mS_col,
+            limit,
+            alpha,
+            glu_linear_offset,
+            beta1,
+            beta2,
+            stream,
+        )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.g2r_kernel is not None):
+            if self.g2r_kernel.eligible_to_dispatch(mGatedInput, mS_col):
+                self.g2r_kernel(*args)
+            else:
+                self.g2s_kernel(*args)
+        else:
+            self.g2s_kernel(*args)
+
+
+class MXFP8QuantizeKernelBase(abc.ABC):
+    """Base class for MXFP8 quantize kernels."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def supports(cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig) -> bool:  # pylint: disable=unused-argument
+        """Compile time check: whether this specialized kernel handles cfg at all."""
+        return False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def eligible_to_dispatch(
+        cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mNoop: cute.Pointer,
+        mDActInput: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ) -> Boolean:
+        """Runtime check: whether we can dispatch to the instantiated kernel with this call's shapes and noops."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @abc.abstractmethod
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mAmax: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mNoop: cute.Pointer,
+        mDActInput: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mWorkspace: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mActTable: cute.Pointer,  # activation table; null without one
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ):
+        """
+        Compiled kernel entrypoint (decorate with @cute.jit).
+        All MXFP8 quantize kernels must implement this interface because this is our C++ call site's contract in `quantize_mxfp8_cutedsl.cuh`.
+        C++ call site will pass the arguments in this exact order via tvm-ffi and the kernel must accept them even if they are not used.
+        """
+
+
+class MXFP8QuantizeEntry(MXFP8QuantizeKernelBase):
+    """Select the appropriate MXFP8 quantization kernel based on the configuration and runtime shapes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig):
+        # Kernels import shared definitions from this module. Resolve their
+        # implementations only when constructing the compile-time entry object.
+        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_g2s_general import MXFP8QuantizeGeneralG2SKernel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_g2r_rowwise_1lane import MXFP8QuantizeRowwise1LaneG2RKernel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_g2s_bidim import MXFP8QuantizeBidimensionalG2SKernel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_g2r_rowwise_2lane import MXFP8QuantizeRowwise2LaneG2RKernel
+        from .quantize_mxfp8_g2r_bidim import MXFP8QuantizeBidimensionalG2RKernel
+
+        # pylint: enable=import-outside-toplevel
+
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        # These activation functions satisfy f(0) = 0 so we don't need to mask with OOB regions
+        # (zeros filled by TMA are still zeros without applying activation to them)
+        # Note that as the time of writing, all activations supported by MXFP8 satisfy this property, so !ACT_NEED_MASKING is never reachable.
+        # This is only a precaution for future use cases if someone wants to add a new activation function.
+        self.ACT_NEED_MASKING = cfg.WITH_ACT and cfg.ACTIVATION not in (
+            "relu",
+            "gelu",
+            "silu",
+            "qgelu",
+            "srelu",
+        )
+        # Instantiate all possible kernels at compile time,
+        # and we will pick the right one at runtime based on the input shape and config.
+        self.general_skip_input_masking_kernel = MXFP8QuantizeGeneralG2SKernel(
+            cfg, SKIP_INPUT_MASKING=True

+    """Compile the CuTeDSL kernel for this config and register it in the TVM-FFI global registry
+    under EXACTLY `fn_name` (the key the C++ dispatcher built; Python treats it as an opaque name).
+    Returns True if a kernel is successfully registered under `fn_name` (the C++ side then fetches it with GetGlobal(fn_name));
+    False if the config is unsupported, so the caller caches the negative result and falls back to the CUDA C++ kernel.
+    """
+    try:
+        # Already registered (e.g. by a prior call) -> supported.
+        if tvm_ffi.get_global_func(fn_name, allow_missing=True) is not None:
+            return True

+        major, minor = device_compute_capability()
+        if major < 10:
+            logger.warning(
+                "CuTeDSL MXFP8 backend requires compute capability >= 10.0 (Blackwell), "
+                "but detected %d.%d; falling back to the CUDA C++ kernel.",
+                major,
+                minor,
+            )
+            return False

+        # wrapper that parses arguments and calls the underlying function. This is needed in the general case
+        # as TVM-FFI is positional-only, however, for us this is unnecessary launch overhead as we pass the
+        # arguments in the correct order on the C++ side.
+        # Relevant issue: https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/issues/3527
+        # https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/pull/3589 recommends using an explicit positional only marker (/)
+        # in the function signature, however it is not merged and it is something easy to miss and silently
+        # introduce unnecessarry overhead.

+        logger.error(
+            "CuTeDSL MXFP8 kernel compilation & registration failed, falling back to the CUDA"
+            " C++ kernel: %s",
+            e,
+        )

+@cute.jit
+def _bf16_nan_magnitudes_to_zero(pair: Uint32) -> Uint32:
+    """A packed pair of BF16 block amaxes with each NaN half replaced by +0.
+
+    With an activation fused, a block of only NaNs gets amax 0 and so scale 0, as in CUDA's
+    generic kernel (0-seeded fmaxf); CUDA's cast kernels, like the plain cast here, give it the NaN
+    scale (cast_bidim.cuh's kNaNReciprocal).
+    """
+    magnitudes = pair & Uint32(0x7FFF7FFF)
+    lo = magnitudes & Uint32(0xFFFF)
+    hi = magnitudes >> Uint32(16)
+    if lo > Uint32(0x7F80):
+        lo = Uint32(0)
+    if hi > Uint32(0x7F80):
+        hi = Uint32(0)
+    return lo | (hi << Uint32(16))
+

+@cute.jit
+def _bf16_mx_scale_reciprocal_fused(
+    magnitude: Uint32, MAX_EXPONENT: cutlass.Constexpr[int]
+) -> Uint32:
+    """bf16_mx_scale_reciprocal with a fused activation: a NaN block amax gives the reciprocal of
+    amax 0 (see _bf16_nan_magnitudes_to_zero). Same instructions, so it costs nothing extra."""
+    rounded = (magnitude + Uint32(31)) & Uint32(0x7F80)
+    if rounded < Uint32(MAX_EXPONENT << 7):  # pylint: disable=consider-using-max-builtin
+        rounded = Uint32(MAX_EXPONENT << 7)
+    reciprocal = Uint32((254 + MAX_EXPONENT) << 7) - rounded
+    if magnitude >= Uint32(0x7F80):
+        reciprocal = Uint32(0x0040)
+        if magnitude != Uint32(0x7F80):
+            reciprocal = Uint32(254 << 7)
+    return reciprocal

+def _gather_partial_colwise_amaxes(

+    scratch_swizzle = cute.make_swizzle(1, 3, 3)

+    )
+
+    sS_col_i32 = cute.composition(sS_col_i32, tv_col_rcp_layout)
+
+    # Each reduction process `REDUCTION_i32_PAIRS` bf16x2 pairs by visiting all rows (CTA_THREADS_Y)
+    # to extract the amax of that column
+    sAmaxs_col_scratch_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(sAmaxs_col_scratch, Int32)
+    MAX_EXPONENT = 8 if FP8_DTYPE is cutlass.Float8E4M3FN else 15
+    if is_reduction_thread:
+        sAmaxs_col_frag_i32 = cute.composition(sAmaxs_col_scratch_i32, tv_col_amaxes_layout)[
+            tidx, None
+        ]
+        # Expose the thread's value mode as (partial rows, column pairs).
+        sAmaxs_col_frag_i32 = cute.composition(
+            sAmaxs_col_frag_i32,
+            cute.make_layout((CTA_THREADS_Y, REDUCTION_i32_PAIRS), stride=(REDUCTION_i32_PAIRS, 1)),
+        )
+
+        # Iterative over all column pairs
+        for pair_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(REDUCTION_i32_PAIRS):
+            # Select the pair column
+            sAmaxs_col_frag_i32_rows = sAmaxs_col_frag_i32[None, pair_idx]
+
+            # Reduce across all rows' partial amaxes to obtain the columnwise amax for this column pair
+            amaxX2 = sAmaxs_col_frag_i32_rows[0]
+            for scratch_row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, CTA_THREADS_Y):
+                amaxX2 = abs_max_x2_bf16(amaxX2, sAmaxs_col_frag_i32_rows[scratch_row_idx])
+
+            if cutlass.const_expr(FUSED):
+                amaxX2 = Int32(_bf16_nan_magnitudes_to_zero(Uint32(amaxX2)))
+            # Obtain the columnwise scale reciprocal for this column pair
+            sS_col_i32[tidx, pair_idx] = bf16_mx_scale_reciprocal_pair(amaxX2, MAX_EXPONENT)
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+    return sS_col
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _write_colwise_scale(
+    rS_col_rcp: cute.Tensor,
+    gS_col_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    # Atoms
+    col_scale_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    # Miscellaneous
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+    # Constexprs
+    CTA_THREADS_X: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    SCALE_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    cols_ok: Boolean = True,
+):
+    """
+    rS_col_rcp: RMEM fragment of this thread's columnwise scale reciprocals with shape (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,)
+    With EDGE, a thread whose columns are past the tensor (not cols_ok) writes none.
+    """
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+
+    rS_col_rcp_u32 = cute.recast_tensor(rS_col_rcp, Uint32)
+
+    # Only threads from CTA's the first row writes the scale fragments
+    if tidx < CTA_THREADS_X:
+        rS_col = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), SCALE_DTYPE)
+        rS_col_u32 = cute.recast_tensor(rS_col, Uint32)
+        # Get the colwise scale from the reciprocal
+        for pack_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+            cute.size(rS_col_u32)
+        ):  # 4 output bytes in one pack
+            rS_col_u32[pack_idx] = bf16_mx_scale_bytes_pair(rS_col_rcp_u32[2 * pack_idx]) | (
+                bf16_mx_scale_bytes_pair(rS_col_rcp_u32[2 * pack_idx + 1]) << Uint32(16)
+            )
+        # Use RMEM buffer to stash the columnwise scale and flush it to GMEM using vectorized store at once
+        if cutlass.const_expr(EDGE):
+            if cols_ok:
+                cute.copy(col_scale_atom, rS_col, gS_col_thread, cache_policy=cache_policy)
+        else:
+            cute.copy(col_scale_atom, rS_col, gS_col_thread, cache_policy=cache_policy)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _apply_colwise_scales(
+    rX: cute.Tensor,
+    rS_col_rcp: cute.Tensor,
+    gO_col_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    # Atoms
+    store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    # Miscellaneous
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+    scale_and_pack: cutlass.Constexpr[Callable[..., Uint32]],
+    # Constexprs
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    FP8_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    rows_left: Int32 = 0,
+):
+    """
+    With EDGE, only the thread's first rows_left rows are stored.
+
+    rX: RMEM fragment of this thread's rows with shape (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD)
+    rS_col_rcp: RMEM fragment of this thread's columnwise scale reciprocals with shape (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,)
+    gO_col_thread: GMEM fragment of this thread's columnwise quantized output with shape
+        (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD)
+
+    This function quantizes its fragments using the input and columnwise scales, and write to its output fragment
+    """
+    rS_col_rcp_u32 = cute.recast_tensor(rS_col_rcp, Uint32)
+
+    rO_col = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), FP8_DTYPE)
+    rO_col_u32 = cute.recast_tensor(rO_col, Uint32)
+
+    # Each thread quantizes its own rows with the columnwise reciprocals and write its output to GMEM.
+    for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+        rX_row_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rX[None, row_idx], Int32)
+        for pack_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+            cute.size(rO_col_u32)
+        ):  # 4 output bytes in one pack
+            rO_col_u32[pack_idx] = scale_and_pack(
+                rX_row_i32[2 * pack_idx],
+                rS_col_rcp_u32[2 * pack_idx],
+                rX_row_i32[2 * pack_idx + 1],
+                rS_col_rcp_u32[2 * pack_idx + 1],
+            )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(EDGE):
+            if row_idx < rows_left:
+                cute.copy(
+                    store_atom, rO_col, gO_col_thread[(None, row_idx),], cache_policy=cache_policy
+                )
+        else:
+            cute.copy(
+                store_atom, rO_col, gO_col_thread[(None, row_idx),], cache_policy=cache_policy
+            )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _quantize_colwise(
+    rX: cute.Tensor,
+    gO_col_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    gS_col_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    # Atoms
+    output_store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    col_scale_store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    # Miscellaneous
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+    scale_and_pack: cutlass.Constexpr[Callable[..., Uint32]],
+    # Constexprs
+    CTA_THREADS_Y: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    CTA_THREADS_X: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    SCALE_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    FP8_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    rows_left: Int32 = 0,
+    cols_ok: Boolean = True,
+    FUSED: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+):
+    """Reduce columnwise amaxes across the CTA, write the columnwise scales, and quantize rX with them.
+    FUSED: an activation is fused (see _bf16_nan_magnitudes_to_zero)."""
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+
+    sAmaxs_col_scratch = _gather_partial_colwise_amaxes(
+        rX,
+        CTA_THREADS_Y=CTA_THREADS_Y,
+        CTA_THREADS_X=CTA_THREADS_X,
+        ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+        DTYPE=DTYPE,
+    )
+
+    sS_col = _reduce_partial_colwise_amaxes(
+        sAmaxs_col_scratch,
+        CTA_THREADS_Y=CTA_THREADS_Y,
+        CTA_THREADS_X=CTA_THREADS_X,
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+        DTYPE=DTYPE,
+        FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+        FUSED=FUSED,
+    )
+
+    # Copy the reduced columnwise scale reciprocals to RMEM.
+    # Threads that quantize different rows share the same columnwise scale
+    rS_col_rcp = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), DTYPE)
+    cute.autovec_copy(sS_col[None, tidx % CTA_THREADS_X], rS_col_rcp)
+
+    _write_colwise_scale(
+        rS_col_rcp,
+        gS_col_thread,
+        col_scale_atom=col_scale_store_atom,
+        cache_policy=cache_policy,
+        CTA_THREADS_X=CTA_THREADS_X,
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+        SCALE_DTYPE=SCALE_DTYPE,
+        EDGE=EDGE,
+        cols_ok=cols_ok,
+    )
+
+    _apply_colwise_scales(
+        rX,
+        rS_col_rcp,
+        gO_col_thread,
+        store_atom=output_store_atom,
+        cache_policy=cache_policy,
+        scale_and_pack=scale_and_pack,
+        ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+        FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+        EDGE=EDGE,
+        rows_left=rows_left,
+    )
+
+
+# FP16 and FP32 inputs scale in FP32, as the CUDA register-tiled kernel and the generic kernel do
+# (2^(127-e) is often outside FP16's range): a block's scale is
+# e8m0(max(amax * MAX_NORM_RCP, 0)), so a block of only NaNs gets the scale of 0 like the
+# generic kernel's 0-seeded fmaxf, and each value is multiplied in FP32 by 2^(127-e) and then
+# converted to FP8.
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _scale_from_amax_f32(amax: Float32, MAX_NORM_RCP: cutlass.Constexpr[float]):
+    """The E8M0 scale of a block with this amax, and its FP32 reciprocal."""
+    biased = cvt_f32_to_fp8e8m0fnu(cute.arch.fmax(amax * Float32(MAX_NORM_RCP), Float32(0.0)))
+    return biased, exp2f_rcp(biased)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _quantize_rowwise_f32_scaled(
+    rX: cute.Tensor,
+    gO_row_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    gS_row_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    output_store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    row_scale_store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+    THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    SCALE_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    FP8_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    MAX_NORM_RCP: cutlass.Constexpr[float],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    rows_left: Int32 = 0,
+):
+    """_quantize_rowwise for FP16 and FP32 values, scaled in FP32."""
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    cvt_x2 = get_cvt_f32x2_to_fp8x2_func(FP8_DTYPE)
+    rS_row = cute.make_rmem_tensor((1,), SCALE_DTYPE)
+    rO_row = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), FP8_DTYPE)
+    rO_row_u16 = cute.recast_tensor(rO_row, Uint16)
+    is_writer_thread = tidx % THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK == 0
+    for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+        amax = Float32(0.0)
+        for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD):
+            amax = cute.arch.fmax(amax, fabs_f32(Float32(rX[col, row_idx])))
+        # The block's amax across the lanes that share it.
+        for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK.bit_length() - 1):
+            amax = cute.arch.fmax(amax, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(amax, 1 << stage))
+        biased, reciprocal = _scale_from_amax_f32(amax, MAX_NORM_RCP)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD // 2):
+            rO_row_u16[pair] = cvt_x2(
+                Float32(rX[2 * pair + 1, row_idx]) * reciprocal,
+                Float32(rX[2 * pair, row_idx]) * reciprocal,
+            )
+        row_ok = Boolean(True)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(EDGE):
+            row_ok = row_idx < rows_left
+        if row_ok:
+            cute.copy(
+                output_store_atom,
+                rO_row,
+                gO_row_thread[(None, row_idx),],
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+            )
+            if is_writer_thread:
+                rS_row[0] = biased
+                cute.copy(
+                    row_scale_store_atom,
+                    rS_row,
+                    cute.local_tile(gS_row_thread, (1,), (row_idx,)),
+                    cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _quantize_colwise_f32_scaled(
+    rX: cute.Tensor,
+    gO_col_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    gS_col_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    output_store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    col_scale_store_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+    CTA_THREADS_Y: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    CTA_THREADS_X: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    SCALE_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    FP8_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    MAX_NORM_RCP: cutlass.Constexpr[float],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    rows_left: Int32 = 0,
+    cols_ok: Boolean = True,
+):
+    """_quantize_colwise for FP16 and FP32 values, scaled in FP32. Thread x of each warp row
+    holds columns [x * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, (x + 1) * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD)."""
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    THREADS = CTA_THREADS_Y * CTA_THREADS_X
+    TILE_COLS = CTA_THREADS_X * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+    cvt_x2 = get_cvt_f32x2_to_fp8x2_func(FP8_DTYPE)
+    allocator = cutlass.memory.SmemAllocator()
+    # Each thread's column maxima over its rows, contiguous per thread.
+    sPartial = allocator.allocate_tensor(
+        Float32,
+        cute.make_layout((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, THREADS), stride=(1, ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD)),
+        byte_alignment=16,
+    )
+    sScale = allocator.allocate_tensor(
+        SCALE_DTYPE, cute.make_layout((TILE_COLS,)), byte_alignment=16
+    )
+    sReciprocal = allocator.allocate_tensor(
+        Float32, cute.make_layout((TILE_COLS,)), byte_alignment=16
+    )
+
+    rPartial = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), Float32)
+    for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD):
+        amax = Float32(0.0)
+        for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+            amax = cute.arch.fmax(amax, fabs_f32(Float32(rX[col, row_idx])))
+        rPartial[col] = amax
+    cute.autovec_copy(rPartial, sPartial[None, tidx])
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+    # One thread per column reduces the warps' maxima: column c is thread (c / X) of each warp
+    # row, element c % X.
+    if tidx < TILE_COLS:
+        owner = tidx // ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        element = tidx % ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        amax = Float32(0.0)
+        for warp_row in cutlass.range_constexpr(CTA_THREADS_Y):
+            amax = cute.arch.fmax(amax, sPartial[element, warp_row * CTA_THREADS_X + owner])
+        biased, reciprocal = _scale_from_amax_f32(amax, MAX_NORM_RCP)
+        sScale[tidx] = biased
+        sReciprocal[tidx] = reciprocal
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+    column0 = (tidx % CTA_THREADS_X) * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+    # The first warp row writes the scales.
+    if tidx < CTA_THREADS_X:
+        rS_col = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), SCALE_DTYPE)
+        for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD):
+            rS_col[col] = sScale[column0 + col]
+        if cols_ok:
+            cute.copy(col_scale_store_atom, rS_col, gS_col_thread, cache_policy=cache_policy)
+
+    rReciprocal = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), Float32)
+    for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD):
+        rReciprocal[col] = sReciprocal[column0 + col]
+    rO_col = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), FP8_DTYPE)
+    rO_col_u16 = cute.recast_tensor(rO_col, Uint16)
+    for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD // 2):
+            rO_col_u16[pair] = cvt_x2(
+                Float32(rX[2 * pair + 1, row_idx]) * rReciprocal[2 * pair + 1],
+                Float32(rX[2 * pair, row_idx]) * rReciprocal[2 * pair],
+            )
+        row_ok = Boolean(True)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(EDGE):
+            row_ok = row_idx < rows_left
+        if row_ok:
+            cute.copy(
+                output_store_atom,
+                rO_col,
+                gO_col_thread[(None, row_idx),],
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+            )
+
+
+def thread_tile_layout(
+    CTA_THREADS_Y: int, CTA_THREADS_X: int, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: int, ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: int
+):
+    """The (thread, value) layout of a register-resident (CTA_THREADS_Y * ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+    CTA_THREADS_X * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD) tile: each warp owns ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD consecutive
+    rows, and each lane ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD adjacent columns."""
+    thread_layout = cute.make_layout((CTA_THREADS_Y, CTA_THREADS_X), stride=(CTA_THREADS_X, 1))
+    _, tv_layout = cute.make_layout_tv(
+        thr_layout=thread_layout,
+        val_layout=cute.make_layout(
+            (ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD), stride=(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, 1)
+        ),
+    )
+    return tv_layout
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def thread_tile_bounds(
+    tile_shape: cute.Shape,
+    tv_layout: cute.Layout,
+    rows_valid: Int32,
+    cols_valid: Int32,
+):
+    """(rows_left, cols_ok) of the calling thread in a tile that ends at rows_valid rows and
+    cols_valid columns: its rows from rows_left on are past the tensor, and all of them when its
+    columns are (a thread's columns lie all inside or all past the tensor)."""
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    thread_origin = cute.composition(cute.make_identity_tensor(tile_shape), tv_layout)[tidx, None][
+        ((0, 0),)
+    ]
+    cols_ok = thread_origin[1] < cols_valid
+    rows_left = rows_valid - thread_origin[0]
+    if not cols_ok:
+        rows_left = Int32(0)
+    return rows_left, cols_ok
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def load_thread_rows(
+    gT_thread: cute.Tensor,
+    rT: cute.Tensor,
+    load_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    rows_left: Int32 = 0,
+):
+    """Copy all rows a thread sweeps into its (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD)
+    register fragment. With EDGE, rows from rows_left on load as zeros."""
+    for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(EDGE):
+            # Predicated loads rather than branches, so the rows' loads still issue together.
+            rT[None, row_idx].fill(0)
+            row_pred = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
+                cute.make_layout((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, (1,)), stride=(0, (0,))), Boolean
+            )
+            row_pred[0] = row_idx < rows_left
+            cute.copy(
+                load_atom,
+                gT_thread[(None, row_idx),],
+                rT[None, row_idx],
+                pred=row_pred,
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+            )
+        else:
+            cute.copy(
+                load_atom, gT_thread[(None, row_idx),], rT[None, row_idx], cache_policy=cache_policy
+            )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def quantize_mxfp8_rmem_tile_bidimensional(
+    rX: cute.Tensor,
+    gO_row_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gS_row_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gO_col_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gS_col_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ROWWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    COLWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    FUSED: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    rows_left: Int32,
+    cols_ok: Boolean,
+    DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    FP8_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    MAX_NORM_RCP: cutlass.Constexpr[float],
+    WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    CTA_THREADS_Y: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    CTA_THREADS_X: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+):
+    """Quantize a register-resident 32-row tile, the CTA's rX fragments (see thread_tile_layout),
+    to the (TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS) output tiles of the directions enabled by ROWWISE / COLWISE.
+    FUSED: the values come from a fused activation (see _bf16_nan_magnitudes_to_zero). With EDGE,
+    rows_left and cols_ok come from thread_tile_bounds."""
+    TILE_ROWS = CTA_THREADS_Y * ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+    THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK = MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE // ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+    THREADS_Y_PER_MX_BLOCK = MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE // ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+    SCALE_DTYPE = cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    tv_layout = thread_tile_layout(
+        CTA_THREADS_Y, CTA_THREADS_X, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+    )
+    store_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+        cute.nvgpu.CopyR2GOp(),
+        FP8_DTYPE,
+        num_bits_per_copy=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD * FP8_DTYPE.width,
+    )
+    scale_and_pack = mul_bf16x2x2_cvt_bf16x4_to_fp8x4(FP8_DTYPE)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(ROWWISE):
+        gO_row_thread = cute.composition(gO_row_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+
+        # Group CTA threads by THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK since they share the same rowwise scale for a MXFP8 block.
+        # And assign stride 0 to that submode
+        tv_row_scale = cute.make_layout(
+            (
+                (THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK, (CTA_THREADS_X // THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK, CTA_THREADS_Y)),
+                ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+            ),
+            stride=(
+                (0, (TILE_ROWS, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD)),
+                1,
+            ),
+        )
+        gS_row_thread = cute.composition(gS_row_tile, tv_row_scale)[tidx, None]
+
+        row_scale_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyR2GOp(), SCALE_DTYPE, num_bits_per_copy=8
+        )
+
+        if cutlass.const_expr(DTYPE is not cutlass.BFloat16):
+            _quantize_rowwise_f32_scaled(
+                rX,
+                gO_row_thread,
+                gS_row_thread,
+                output_store_atom=store_atom,
+                row_scale_store_atom=row_scale_atom,
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK=THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK,
+                ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+                ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+                SCALE_DTYPE=SCALE_DTYPE,
+                FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+                MAX_NORM_RCP=MAX_NORM_RCP,
+                EDGE=EDGE,
+                rows_left=rows_left,
+            )
+        else:
+            _quantize_rowwise(
+                rX,
+                gO_row_thread,
+                gS_row_thread,
+                output_store_atom=store_atom,
+                row_scale_store_atom=row_scale_atom,
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                scale_and_pack=scale_and_pack,
+                THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK=THREADS_X_PER_MX_BLOCK,
+                ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+                ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+                SCALE_DTYPE=SCALE_DTYPE,
+                FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+                EDGE=EDGE,
+                rows_left=rows_left,
+                FUSED=FUSED,
+            )
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(COLWISE):
+        gO_col_thread = cute.composition(gO_col_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+
+        # Group CTA threads by THREADS_Y_PER_MX_BLOCK since they share the same columnwise scale for a MXFP8 block.
+        # And assign stride 0 to that submode
+        tv_col_scale = cute.make_layout(
+            (
+                (CTA_THREADS_X, (THREADS_Y_PER_MX_BLOCK, CTA_THREADS_Y // THREADS_Y_PER_MX_BLOCK)),
+                ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+            ),
+            stride=(
+                (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, (0, 1)),
+                1,
+            ),
+        )
+        # If CTA_THREADS_Y // THREADS_Y_PER_MX_BLOCK == 1, this will help compiler derive alignment
+        # Otherwise coalesce will not do anything which is still fine
+        tv_col_scale = cute.coalesce(tv_col_scale, target_profile=(1, 1))
+        gS_col_thread = cute.composition(gS_col_tile, tv_col_scale)[tidx, None]
+
+        # GEMM-swizzled colwise scales are not contiguous (adjacent columns land 16 bytes apart),
+        # so they are stored a byte at a time, as the general kernel does.
+        col_scale_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyR2GOp(),
+            SCALE_DTYPE,
+            num_bits_per_copy=8 if WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES else ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD * 8,
+        )
+
+        if cutlass.const_expr(DTYPE is not cutlass.BFloat16):
+            _quantize_colwise_f32_scaled(
+                rX,
+                gO_col_thread,
+                gS_col_thread,
+                output_store_atom=store_atom,
+                col_scale_store_atom=col_scale_atom,
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                CTA_THREADS_Y=CTA_THREADS_Y,
+                CTA_THREADS_X=CTA_THREADS_X,
+                ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+                ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+                SCALE_DTYPE=SCALE_DTYPE,
+                FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+                MAX_NORM_RCP=MAX_NORM_RCP,
+                EDGE=EDGE,
+                rows_left=rows_left,
+                cols_ok=cols_ok,
+            )
+        else:
+            _quantize_colwise(
+                rX,
+                gO_col_thread,
+                gS_col_thread,
+                output_store_atom=store_atom,
+                col_scale_store_atom=col_scale_atom,
+                cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                scale_and_pack=scale_and_pack,
+                CTA_THREADS_Y=CTA_THREADS_Y,
+                CTA_THREADS_X=CTA_THREADS_X,
+                ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+                ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+                SCALE_DTYPE=SCALE_DTYPE,
+                DTYPE=DTYPE,
+                FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+                EDGE=EDGE,
+                rows_left=rows_left,
+                cols_ok=cols_ok,
+                FUSED=FUSED,
+            )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def quantize_mxfp8_gmem_tile_bidimensional(
+    gX_tile: cute.Tensor,
+    gA_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gO_row_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gS_row_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gO_col_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    gS_col_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ROWWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    COLWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    ACTIVATION: cutlass.Constexpr[Optional[str]],
+    ACTIVATION_TABLE: cutlass.Constexpr[str],
+    sTable: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    sDbias: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    EDGE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    rows_valid: Int32,
+    cols_valid: Int32,
+    WITH_AMAX: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    WITH_ACT: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    WITH_DACT: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    FP8_DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[Type[cutlass.Numeric]],
+    MAX_NORM_RCP: cutlass.Constexpr[float],
+    WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    CTA_THREADS_Y: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    CTA_THREADS_X: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    cache_policy: Int64,
+):
+    """Quantize one (TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS) GMEM tile in the directions enabled by ROWWISE / COLWISE.
+
+    TILE_ROWS = CTA_THREADS_Y * ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD = 32, so every columnwise
+    MXFP8 block is contained in the tile. Each warp owns ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+    consecutive rows, and each lane owns ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD adjacent columns.
+    Load the tile once, then reuse its registers for each enabled quantization pass.
+    The tensors of a disabled direction are unused and may be None.
+    """
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+
+    tv_layout = thread_tile_layout(
+        CTA_THREADS_Y, CTA_THREADS_X, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+    )
+
+    gX_thread = cute.composition(gX_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+
+    # Input fragment contains all rows it handles; output fragment contains only one row and we write it back row by row
+    rX = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD), DTYPE)
+
+    load_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+        cute.nvgpu.CopyG2ROp(),
+        DTYPE,
+        num_bits_per_copy=min(
+            ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD * DTYPE.width,
+            max_num_bits_per_copy_ld_global(),
+        ),
+        # TODO(kainingz): due to https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/issues/3726 using
+        # invariant=True here will drop the cache policy
+        invariant=False,
+    )
+    # With EDGE the tile ends at rows_valid rows and cols_valid columns: the thread's rows from
+    # rows_left on are past the tensor, and all of them when its columns are (a thread's columns
+    # lie all inside or all past the tensor, as N % 16 == 0). They load as zeros, which leave
+    # the column amaxes and dbias unchanged, and are not stored.
+    rows_left = Int32(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD)
+    cols_ok = Boolean(True)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(EDGE):
+        rows_left, cols_ok = thread_tile_bounds(gX_tile.shape, tv_layout, rows_valid, cols_valid)
+
+    # Copy all rows a thread sweeps into the RMEM fragment at once
+    load_thread_rows(
+        gX_thread,
+        rX,
+        load_atom,
+        cache_policy,
+        ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+        EDGE=EDGE,
+        rows_left=rows_left,
+    )
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(WITH_ACT or WITH_DACT):
+        rA = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD), DTYPE)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(WITH_DACT):
+            act_load_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.CopyG2ROp(),
+                DTYPE,
+                num_bits_per_copy=min(
+                    ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD * DTYPE.width,
+                    max_num_bits_per_copy_ld_global(),
+                ),
+                invariant=False,
+            )
+            # Activation tile has the same layout as the input tile so we can reuse the tv layout
+            gA_thread = cute.composition(gA_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+            load_thread_rows(
+                gA_thread,
+                rA,
+                act_load_atom,
+                cache_policy,
+                ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+                ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+                EDGE=EDGE,
+                rows_left=rows_left,
+            )
+        # With dbias, the FP32 products are staged for the column sums (see _kernel_main).
+        if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+            sDbias_thread = cute.composition(sDbias, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+        # Apply activation row by row
+        if cutlass.const_expr(DTYPE is not cutlass.BFloat16):
+            # FP16 and FP32: per value in FP32, rounded to the input type, as the generic
+            # kernel does; dbias takes the FP32 products before rounding.
+            for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                    rProducts = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), Float32)
+                for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD):
+                    x = Float32(rX[col, row_idx])
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(WITH_DACT):
+                        dop = dactivation_op(ACTIVATION, ACTIVATION_TABLE)
+                        x = x * dop(Float32(rA[col, row_idx]))
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                            rProducts[col] = x
+                    else:
+                        x = activation_op(ACTIVATION, ACTIVATION_TABLE)(x)
+                    rX[col, row_idx] = DTYPE(x)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                    cute.autovec_copy(rProducts, sDbias_thread[(None, row_idx),])
+        else:
+            for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+                rX_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rX[None, row_idx], Int32)
+                rA_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rA[None, row_idx], Int32)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                    rProducts = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,), Float32)
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD // 2):
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION_TABLE != "none"):
+                        # Read the activation from the table, as the CUDA register-tiled kernel does.
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(WITH_DACT):
+                            low, high, end, stride = DERIVATIVE_TABLE_WINDOWS[
+                                (ACTIVATION, ACTIVATION_TABLE)
+                            ]
+                            d_lo, d_hi = table_derivative_2x(
+                                rA_i32[i],
+                                cute.recast_tensor(sTable, Float32),
+                                LO=low,
+                                HI=high,
+                                SATURATED_END=end,
+                                STRIDE=stride,
+                                SLOPE=DERIVATIVE_SLOPES[ACTIVATION],
+                            )
+                            lo = x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(rX_i32[i]) * d_lo
+                            hi = x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(rX_i32[i]) * d_hi
+                            if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                                rProducts[2 * i] = lo
+                                rProducts[2 * i + 1] = hi
+                            rX_i32[i] = cvt_f32x2_to_bf16x2(lo, hi)
+                        else:
+                            low, high = FORWARD_TABLE_WINDOWS[ACTIVATION]
+                            rX_i32[i] = table_forward_2x(
+                                rX_i32[i],
+                                cute.recast_tensor(sTable, Uint16),
+                                LOW_SENTINEL=low - 1,
+                                HIGH_SENTINEL=high + 1,
+                            )
+                    else:
+                        lo = x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(rX_i32[i])
+                        hi = x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(rX_i32[i])
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(WITH_DACT):
+                            dop = dactivation_op(ACTIVATION, ACTIVATION_TABLE)
+                            lo = lo * dop(x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(rA_i32[i]))
+                            hi = hi * dop(x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(rA_i32[i]))
+                            if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                                rProducts[2 * i] = lo
+                                rProducts[2 * i + 1] = hi
+                        else:
+                            op = activation_op(ACTIVATION, ACTIVATION_TABLE)
+                            lo = op(lo)
+                            hi = op(hi)
+                        rX_i32[i] = cvt_f32x2_to_bf16x2(lo, hi)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(sDbias is not None):
+                    cute.autovec_copy(rProducts, sDbias_thread[(None, row_idx),])
+
+    # The thread's amax of the values it quantizes (the activation rounded to BF16). Like the
+    # CUDA kernels' fmaxf, it ignores NaN: the BF16 max returns the other operand of a NaN, and
+    # the FP32 fmax drops a pair of NaNs.
+    thread_amax = Float32(0.0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(WITH_AMAX and DTYPE is not cutlass.BFloat16):
+        for row_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD):
+            for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD):
+                thread_amax = cute.arch.fmax(thread_amax, fabs_f32(Float32(rX[col, row_idx])))
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(WITH_AMAX):
+        rX_all_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rX, Int32)
+        pair_amax = rX_all_i32[0]
+        for word in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, cute.size(rX_all_i32)):
+            pair_amax = abs_max_x2_bf16(pair_amax, rX_all_i32[word])
+        thread_amax = cute.arch.fmax(
+            fabs_f32(x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(pair_amax)), fabs_f32(x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(pair_amax))
+        )
+
+    quantize_mxfp8_rmem_tile_bidimensional(
+        rX,
+        gO_row_tile,
+        gS_row_tile,
+        gO_col_tile,
+        gS_col_tile,
+        ROWWISE=ROWWISE,
+        COLWISE=COLWISE,
+        FUSED=WITH_ACT or WITH_DACT,
+        EDGE=EDGE,
+        rows_left=rows_left,
+        cols_ok=cols_ok,
+        DTYPE=DTYPE,
+        FP8_DTYPE=FP8_DTYPE,
+        MAX_NORM_RCP=MAX_NORM_RCP,
+        WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES=WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES,
+        CTA_THREADS_Y=CTA_THREADS_Y,
+        CTA_THREADS_X=CTA_THREADS_X,
+        ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+        cache_policy=cache_policy,
+    )
+
+    return thread_amax
+
+
+class MXFP8QuantizeBidimensionalG2RKernel(MXFP8QuantizeKernelBase):
+    """Load one CTA tile into registers and quantize it along both axes.
+
+    TILE_ROWS = _CTA_THREADS_Y * _ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD = 32.
+    TILE_COLS = _CTA_THREADS_X * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD = 256 or 512.
+    The 32-row tile contains complete columnwise MXFP8 blocks; shared memory
+    combines the partial column maxima from the eight warps. Requires aligned
+    BF16 input, M divisible by 32 and N divisible by 256; writes packed or GEMM-swizzled
+    scales.
+    """
+
+    _CTA_THREADS_Y = 8
+    _CTA_THREADS_X = 32
+    # With a table, the grid holds about this many columns' worth of CTAs (16384 CTAs of 256
+    # columns, as in the CUDA register-tiled kernel); each CTA walks the remaining row tiles.
+    _WALK_TARGET_COLS = 16384 * 256
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def supports(cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig) -> bool:
+        # BF16 packed math; FP16 and FP32 scaled in FP32, only with a fused activation.
+        # dbias only fused with an activation derivative, like the CUDA register-tiled kernel;
+        # amax only with a fused activation; plain casts with amax take the general kernel.
+        return (
+            (not cfg.WITH_AMAX or cfg.WITH_ACT or cfg.WITH_DACT)
+            and (not cfg.WITH_DBIAS or cfg.WITH_DACT)
+            and (
+                cfg.DTYPE is cutlass.BFloat16
+                or MXFP8QuantizeBidimensionalG2RKernel.takes_scaled_in_f32(cfg)
+            )
+            and cfg.COLWISE
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def takes_scaled_in_f32(cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig) -> bool:
+        """Whether an FP16 or FP32 request takes this kernel: the fused activations where it is
+        faster than the general kernel. GB200, geometric mean speedup over TE main, general ->
+        this kernel: FP16 GeLU 1.46 -> 1.62, SiLU 1.41 -> 1.69, dGeLU 1.56 -> 1.69, dSiLU
+        1.28 -> 1.76, dbias_dSiLU 1.48 -> 1.74; FP32 SiLU 1.32 -> 1.54, dGeLU 1.38 -> 1.52,
+        dSiLU 1.10 -> 1.85, dbias_dSiLU 1.18 -> 1.53, dbias_dGeLU 1.47 -> 1.25 (CUDA 1.30; the
+        general kernel's FP32 dbias differs from CUDA's in the last bit, this kernel's matches).
+        FP16 dbias_dGeLU (1.75 -> 1.50) and FP32 GeLU (1.20 -> 1.16) keep the general kernel."""
+        if not (cfg.WITH_ACT or cfg.WITH_DACT):
+            return False
+        if cfg.WITH_DBIAS and cfg.ACTIVATION == "dgelu" and cfg.DTYPE is cutlass.Float16:
+            return False
+        return not (cfg.DTYPE is cutlass.Float32 and cfg.ACTIVATION == "gelu")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def eligible_to_dispatch(
+        cfg: cutlass.Constexpr[MXFP8QuantizeConfig],
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mNoop: cute.Pointer,
+        mDActInput: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ) -> Boolean:
+        M, N = mX.shape
+        act_input_aligned = Boolean(True)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(mDActInput is not None):
+            act_input_aligned = mDActInput.iterator.toint() % 32 == 0
+        # Whole 32-row by 256-column tiles (any shape with N % 16 == 0 for the requests in
+        # takes_tails), grid.y within limits, and aligned input and colwise-scale pointers.
+        shape_ok = Boolean(True)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(MXFP8QuantizeBidimensionalG2RKernel.takes_tails(cfg)):
+            shape_ok = N % 16 == 0
+        else:
+            shape_ok = M % 32 == 0 and N % 256 == 0
+        return (
+            shape_ok
+            and (M + 31) // 32 <= 65535
+            and mX.iterator.toint() % 32 == 0
+            and act_input_aligned
+            and mS_col.iterator.toint() % 16 == 0
+            and mNoop.toint() == 0
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def takes_tails(cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig) -> bool:
+        """Whether this config takes row and column tails (any row count, N % 16 == 0): the
+        derivatives and the requests with a table or amax, as the CUDA register-tiled kernel
+        does. The others keep whole 32-row by 256-column tiles."""
+        return (
+            cfg.ACTIVATION_TABLE != "none"
+            or cfg.WITH_DACT
+            or cfg.WITH_AMAX
+            or cfg.DTYPE is not cutlass.BFloat16
+        )
+
+    def __init__(self, cfg: MXFP8QuantizeConfig):
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        # FP32 values take twice the registers: twice the warps, each with half the rows, and
+        # half the resident CTAs per SM, as in the CUDA register-tiled kernel.
+        self._MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP = 4
+        if cfg.DTYPE is cutlass.Float32:
+            self._CTA_THREADS_Y = 16
+            self._MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP = 2
+        # One CTA only quantize one columnwise MXFP8 block at a time
+        self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD = MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE // self._CTA_THREADS_Y  # 4
+        # SMs of the device compiled for, which set the walk length with a table or dbias.
+        self._sm_count = 0
+        if cfg.ACTIVATION_TABLE != "none" or cfg.WITH_DBIAS:
+            from cuda.core import (
+                Device,
+            )  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,no-name-in-module
+
+            self._sm_count = HardwareInfo(Device().device_id).get_device_multiprocessor_count()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mAmax: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mNoop: cute.Pointer,  # Unused: the dispatcher routes noop calls to the general kernel
+        mDActInput: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mWorkspace: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mActTable: cute.Pointer,  # activation table; null without one
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ):
+        M, N = mX.shape
+        TILE_ROWS = self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+        WIDE_TILE_COLS = self._CTA_THREADS_X * 16
+        # A derivative holds the gradient and the activation input in registers: 256-column tiles
+        # keep it under the register budget (wider tiles spill), and clusters do not help it.
+        # With dbias, the staged FP32 products of a 256-column tile take 32 KB of shared memory.

+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mA: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_row: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_row: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_col: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_col: cute.Tensor,
+        mActTable: cute.Pointer,
+        walk: Int32,
+        mWorkspace: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mAmax: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+        TAILS: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    ):
+        """Run the kernel body. Like the CUDA specialized cast kernels it does not consume the
+        cast_noop flag: the dispatcher routes calls with one to the general kernel."""
+        self._kernel_main(
+            mX,
+            mA,
+            mO_row,
+            mS_row,
+            mO_col,
+            mS_col,
+            mActTable,
+            walk,
+            mWorkspace,
+            mAmax,
+            ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,

+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _data_tile(
+        self,
+        mT: cute.Tensor,
+        row_tile: Int32,
+        cta_col: Int32,
+        TILER: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        DYNAMIC_STRIDE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+        ALIGNMENT: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    ) -> cute.Tensor:
+        """The (row_tile, cta_col) tile of mT. With a run-time row stride, the tile's base takes the
+        64-bit product once and offsets within the tile are 32-bit, as in the CUDA register-tiled
+        kernel: the full 64-bit layout costs registers and instructions on every access."""
+        if cutlass.const_expr(DYNAMIC_STRIDE):
+            N = mT.shape[1]
+            base = Int64(row_tile) * Int64(TILER[0]) * Int64(N) + Int64(cta_col) * Int64(TILER[1])
+            return cute.make_tensor(
+                (mT.iterator + base).align(ALIGNMENT),
+                cute.make_layout(TILER, stride=(Int32(N), 1)),
+            )
+        return cute.local_tile(mT, TILER, (row_tile, cta_col))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _kernel_main(
+        self,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mA: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_row: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_row: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_col: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_col: cute.Tensor,
+        mActTable: cute.Pointer,
+        walk: Int32,
+        mWorkspace: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mAmax: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+        TAILS: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    ):
+        """Run bidimensional quantization on the CTA's row tiles: blockIdx.y, and with a table
+        every gridDim.y-th row tile after it, walk tiles in all."""
+        cta_col, first_cta_row, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        _, grid_rows, _ = cute.arch.grid_dim()
+
+        cache_policy = create_l2_policy(True)
+
+        # With a table, copy it into shared memory once for all of the CTA's row tiles.
+        sTable = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.ACTIVATION_TABLE != "none"):
+            TABLE_WORDS = (
+                activation_table_bytes(self.cfg.ACTIVATION, self.cfg.ACTIVATION_TABLE) // 4
+            )
+            tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            allocator = cutlass.memory.SmemAllocator()
+            sTable = allocator.allocate_tensor(
+                Uint32, cute.make_layout((TABLE_WORDS,)), byte_alignment=16
+            )
+            # 16-byte pieces: TE allocates the table 16-byte aligned and padded.
+            piece_layout = cute.make_layout((4, TABLE_WORDS // 4), stride=(1, 4))
+            gTable = cute.make_tensor(
+                cute.recast_ptr(mActTable, dtype=Uint32).align(16), piece_layout
+            )
+            sTable_pieces = cute.make_tensor(sTable.iterator, piece_layout)
+            for piece in cutlass.range(
+                tidx, TABLE_WORDS // 4, self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._CTA_THREADS_X, unroll=1
+            ):
+                cute.autovec_copy(gTable[None, piece], sTable_pieces[None, piece])
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+        thread_amax = Float32(0.0)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.WITH_DBIAS):
+            # dbias in the CUDA kernels' order: each 64-row chunk's FP32 products summed down the
+            # column in row order, one workspace row per chunk (reduced by the caller). The CTA
+            # takes the chunk's two row tiles back to back; each stages its products in shared
+            # memory, and one thread per column adds them to the column's running sum.
+            TILE_ROWS = self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+            TILE_COLS = self._CTA_THREADS_X * ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+            tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            sDbias = cutlass.memory.SmemAllocator().allocate_tensor(
+                Float32,
+                cute.make_layout((TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS), stride=(TILE_COLS, 1)),
+                byte_alignment=16,
+            )
+            for step in cutlass.range(walk, unroll=1):
+                chunk = step * grid_rows + first_cta_row
+                column_sum = Float32(0.0)
+                # A run-time loop, so the tile body (and its shared memory) is emitted once.
+                for half in cutlass.range(2, unroll=1):
+                    # With a row tail, the last chunk of an odd row-tile count has no second
+                    # tile; its rows would add zeros, which leave a sum that starts at +0
+                    # unchanged.

+                    if cutlass.const_expr(TAILS):

+                    if tile_in_tensor:

+                            mX,
+                            mA,
+                            mO_row,
+                            mS_row,
+                            mO_col,
+                            mS_col,
+                            sTable,
+                            2 * chunk + half,
+                            cta_col,
+                            cache_policy,
+                            sDbias=sDbias,
+                            ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+                            TAILS=TAILS,

+                        cute.arch.sync_threads()
