+    TILER: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ALIGNMENT: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+) -> cute.Tensor:
+    """The (row_tile, cta_col) tile of a row-major mT, which may be a column slice of a wider
+    tensor (row stride 2N): the tile's base takes the 64-bit product once and offsets within the
+    tile are 32-bit, as in the CUDA register-tiled kernel. Every row stride is N or 2N, and the C++
+    dispatcher requires N % 32 == 0."""
+    row_stride = cute.assume(Int32(mT.layout.stride[0]), divby=32)
+    base = Int64(row_tile) * Int64(TILER[0]) * Int64(row_stride) + Int64(cta_col) * Int64(TILER[1])
+    return cute.make_tensor(
+        (mT.iterator + base).align(ALIGNMENT),
+        cute.make_layout(TILER, stride=(row_stride, 1)),
+    )
+
+
+class MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2RKernel:
+    """Register-resident gated MXFP8 cast: BF16 [M, 2N] -> E4M3 or E5M2, both directions or
+    columnwise only, any M, N % 32 == 0 (the C++ dispatcher's requirement)."""
+
+    _CTA_THREADS_Y = 8
+    _CTA_THREADS_X = 32
+    _ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD = 4  # 8 warps x 4 rows = one 32-row band
+    _ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD = 8  # 32 lanes x 8 columns = 256 columns
+    _ROWS_IN_FLIGHT = 4  # input rows loaded at a time
+    # Row bands per CTA, as in gated_bidim.cuh: halve the grid while it holds more than
+    # _WALK_TARGET_CTAS CTAs, walk at least _MIN_WALK bands unless that leaves fewer than two CTAs
+    # per SM, and at most _MAX_WALK.
+    _WALK_TARGET_CTAS = 16384
+    _MIN_WALK = 2
+    _MAX_WALK = 64
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def supports(cfg: MXFP8GatedQuantizeConfig) -> bool:
+        """BF16 with columnwise output (rowwise optional); GEMM-swizzled scales in the forward
+        only, like the shared-memory port."""
+        return (
+            cfg.DTYPE is cutlass.BFloat16
+            and cfg.COLWISE
+            and not (cfg.IS_BWD and cfg.WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES)
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def eligible_to_dispatch(
+        mGatedInput: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_col: cute.Tensor,
+    ) -> Boolean:
+        # The C++ dispatcher checks 16-byte alignment of the data pointers. Columnwise scales are
+        # stored eight bytes per thread, and grid.y stays within limits.
+        M = mGatedInput.shape[0]
+        return (M + 31) // 32 <= 65535 and mS_col.iterator.toint() % 8 == 0
+
+    def __init__(self, cfg: MXFP8GatedQuantizeConfig):
+        assert self.supports(cfg), f"{cfg} is not supported by {type(self).__name__}"
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        # 4 resident CTAs per SM (64 registers), loading all 4 input rows at once. GB200, BF16,
+        # against gated_bidim.cuh, geometric mean over 5 shapes: forward 6 CTAs with 2 rows in
+        # flight (40 registers, spills) 0.91, 4 CTAs with 4 rows 0.93; backward 2 rows 0.92,
+        # 4 rows 0.94.
+        self._MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP = 4
+        from cuda.core import Device  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,no-name-in-module
+
+        self._sm_count = HardwareInfo(Device().device_id).get_device_multiprocessor_count()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mGatedInput: cute.Tensor,  # [M, 2N] = [act | gate]
+        mGrad: Optional[cute.Tensor],  # [M, N], backward only
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],  # [M, C], C = N (forward) or 2N (backward)
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: cute.Tensor,  # [M, C], not transposed
+        mS_col: cute.Tensor,
+        limit: Optional[Float32],  # Clamped SwiGLU only
+        alpha: Optional[Float32],  # Clamped SwiGLU only
+        glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],  # Clamped SwiGLU only
+        beta1: Optional[Float32],  # SiTUGLU only
+        beta2: Optional[Float32],  # SiTUGLU only
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(CUTEDSL_DEBUG_LOGGING):
+            cute.printf(
+                f"[CuTeDSL] MXFP8GatedQuantizeG2RKernel.__call__() with config: {self.cfg}\n"
+            )
+        M = mGatedInput.shape[0]
+        N = mO_col.shape[1] if not self.cfg.IS_BWD else mGrad.shape[1]
+        TILE_ROWS = self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+        TILE_COLS = self._CTA_THREADS_X * self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+
+        # eligible_to_dispatch checks this alignment: each thread stores eight columnwise scales.
+        mS_col = cute.make_tensor(mS_col.iterator.align(8), mS_col.layout)
+        mAct = cute.local_tile(mGatedInput, (M, N), (0, 0))
+        mGate = cute.local_tile(mGatedInput, (M, N), (0, 1))
+
+        # Output parts: the forward output, or the two halves [d act | d gate] of the backward one.
+        mO_row1 = mS_row1 = mO_col1 = mS_col1 = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.IS_BWD):
+            mS_row0, mS_row1, mS_col0, mS_col1 = _split_gated_scales(
+                mS_row, mS_col, M, N, self.cfg.ROWWISE, True, False
+            )
+            mO_row0 = None
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.ROWWISE):
+                mO_row0 = cute.local_tile(mO_row, (M, N), (0, 0))
+                mO_row1 = cute.local_tile(mO_row, (M, N), (0, 1))
+            mO_col0 = cute.local_tile(mO_col, (M, N), (0, 0))
+            mO_col1 = cute.local_tile(mO_col, (M, N), (0, 1))
+        else:
+            mO_row0, mO_col0 = mO_row, mO_col
+            mS_row0, mS_col0 = mS_row, mS_col
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES):
+                mS_row0, mS_col0 = derive_swizzled_scale_layout(
+                    M, N, self.cfg.ROWWISE, True, mS_row, mS_col
+                )
+
+        grid_cols = (N + TILE_COLS - 1) // TILE_COLS
+        bands = (M + TILE_ROWS - 1) // TILE_ROWS
+        min_walk = Int32(self._MIN_WALK)
+        if grid_cols * (bands // self._MIN_WALK) < 2 * self._sm_count:
+            min_walk = Int32(1)
+        walk = Int32(1)
+        while (bands // walk) % 2 == 0 and grid_cols * (bands // walk) > self._WALK_TARGET_CTAS:
+            walk *= 2
+        if walk < min_walk and bands % min_walk == 0:
+            walk = min_walk
+        if walk > self._MAX_WALK:
+            walk = Int32(self._MAX_WALK)
+
+        # A tensor with a row or column tail takes the kernel whose tiles are predicated.
+        if M % TILE_ROWS != 0 or N % TILE_COLS != 0:
+            self.kernel(
+                mAct,
+                mGate,
+                mGrad,
+                mO_row0,
+                mS_row0,
+                mO_col0,
+                mS_col0,
+                mO_row1,
+                mS_row1,
+                mO_col1,
+                mS_col1,
+                limit,
+                alpha,
+                glu_linear_offset,
+                beta1,
+                beta2,
+                walk,
+                TAILS=True,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=[grid_cols, bands // walk],
+                block=[self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._CTA_THREADS_X],
+                min_blocks_per_mp=self._MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP,
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.kernel(
+                mAct,
+                mGate,
+                mGrad,
+                mO_row0,
+                mS_row0,
+                mO_col0,
+                mS_col0,
+                mO_row1,
+                mS_row1,
+                mO_col1,
+                mS_col1,
+                limit,
+                alpha,
+                glu_linear_offset,
+                beta1,
+                beta2,
+                walk,
+                TAILS=False,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=[grid_cols, bands // walk],
+                block=[self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._CTA_THREADS_X],
+                min_blocks_per_mp=self._MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP,
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mAct: cute.Tensor,
+        mGate: cute.Tensor,
+        mGrad: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_row0: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row0: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col0: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_col0: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        limit: Optional[Float32],
+        alpha: Optional[Float32],
+        glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],
+        beta1: Optional[Float32],
+        beta2: Optional[Float32],
+        walk: Int32,
+        TAILS: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    ):
+        """Quantize the CTA's row bands: blockIdx.y and every gridDim.y-th band after it, walk
+        bands in all."""
+        cta_col, first_cta_row, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        _, grid_rows, _ = cute.arch.grid_dim()
+        cache_policy = create_l2_policy(True)
+        TILE_ROWS = self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+        TILE_COLS = self._CTA_THREADS_X * self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        for step in cutlass.range(walk, unroll=1):
+            row_tile = step * grid_rows + first_cta_row
+            # With TAILS, only the bands that cross the tensor's edge take the predicated body.
+            if cutlass.const_expr(TAILS):
+                if (row_tile + 1) * TILE_ROWS > mAct.shape[0] or (
+                    cta_col + 1
+                ) * TILE_COLS > mAct.shape[1]:
+                    self._gated_row_tile(
+                        mAct,
+                        mGate,
+                        mGrad,
+                        mO_row0,
+                        mS_row0,
+                        mO_col0,
+                        mS_col0,
+                        mO_row1,
+                        mS_row1,
+                        mO_col1,
+                        mS_col1,
+                        limit,
+                        alpha,
+                        glu_linear_offset,
+                        beta1,
+                        beta2,
+                        row_tile,
+                        cta_col,
+                        cache_policy,
+                        TAILS=True,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self._gated_row_tile(
+                        mAct,
+                        mGate,
+                        mGrad,
+                        mO_row0,
+                        mS_row0,
+                        mO_col0,
+                        mS_col0,
+                        mO_row1,
+                        mS_row1,
+                        mO_col1,
+                        mS_col1,
+                        limit,
+                        alpha,
+                        glu_linear_offset,
+                        beta1,
+                        beta2,
+                        row_tile,
+                        cta_col,
+                        cache_policy,
+                        TAILS=False,
+                    )
+            else:
+                self._gated_row_tile(
+                    mAct,
+                    mGate,
+                    mGrad,
+                    mO_row0,
+                    mS_row0,
+                    mO_col0,
+                    mS_col0,
+                    mO_row1,
+                    mS_row1,
+                    mO_col1,
+                    mS_col1,
+                    limit,
+                    alpha,
+                    glu_linear_offset,
+                    beta1,
+                    beta2,
+                    row_tile,
+                    cta_col,
+                    cache_policy,
+                    TAILS=False,
+                )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _quantize_part(
+        self,
+        rX: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_col: cute.Tensor,
+        row_tile: Int32,
+        cta_col: Int32,
+        rows_left: Int32,
+        cols_ok: Boolean,
+        cache_policy: Int64,
+        TAILS: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    ):
+        """Quantize one output part of the band from its register tile."""
+        TILE_ROWS = self._CTA_THREADS_Y * self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+        TILE_COLS = self._CTA_THREADS_X * self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        TILER = (TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS)
+        cta_coord = (row_tile, cta_col)
+        gO_row_tile = gS_row_tile = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.ROWWISE):
+            gO_row_tile = _row_tile(mO_row, row_tile, cta_col, TILER, 16)
+            gS_row_tile = cute.local_tile(mS_row, (TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS // 32), cta_coord)
+        gO_col_tile = _row_tile(mO_col, row_tile, cta_col, TILER, 16)
+        gS_col_tile = cute.local_tile(mS_col, (TILE_ROWS // 32, TILE_COLS), cta_coord)
+        quantize_mxfp8_rmem_tile_bidimensional(
+            rX,
+            gO_row_tile,
+            gS_row_tile,
+            gO_col_tile,
+            gS_col_tile,
+            ROWWISE=self.cfg.ROWWISE,
+            COLWISE=True,
+            # The gated kernel's block amaxes ignore NaN like the generic kernel's.
+            FUSED=True,
+            EDGE=TAILS,
+            rows_left=rows_left,
+            cols_ok=cols_ok,
+            DTYPE=self.cfg.DTYPE,
+            FP8_DTYPE=self.cfg.FP8_DTYPE,
+            MAX_NORM_RCP=self.cfg.MAX_NORM_RCP,
+            WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES=self.cfg.WITH_GEMM_SWIZZLED_SCALES,
+            CTA_THREADS_Y=self._CTA_THREADS_Y,
+            CTA_THREADS_X=self._CTA_THREADS_X,
+            ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD=self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD,
+            ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD=self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD,
+            cache_policy=cache_policy,
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _thread_view(self, mT: cute.Tensor, row_tile: Int32, cta_col: Int32) -> cute.Tensor:
+        """The calling thread's (ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD, ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD) values of the
+        (row_tile, cta_col) band of mT, in global memory."""
+        ELEMENTS_Y = self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+        ELEMENTS_X = self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        TILER = (self._CTA_THREADS_Y * ELEMENTS_Y, self._CTA_THREADS_X * ELEMENTS_X)
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        tv_layout = thread_tile_layout(
+            self._CTA_THREADS_Y, self._CTA_THREADS_X, ELEMENTS_Y, ELEMENTS_X
+        )
+        return cute.composition(_row_tile(mT, row_tile, cta_col, TILER, 16), tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _load_rows(
+        self,
+        gT_thread: cute.Tensor,
+        first_row: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+        rows_left: Int32,
+        cache_policy: Int64,
+        TAILS: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    ) -> cute.Tensor:
+        """Rows first_row .. first_row + _ROWS_IN_FLIGHT - 1 of the thread's values, in
+        registers; with TAILS, rows from rows_left on load as zeros."""
+        DTYPE = self.cfg.DTYPE
+        ELEMENTS_X = self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        load_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyG2ROp(),
+            DTYPE,
+            num_bits_per_copy=min(ELEMENTS_X * DTYPE.width, max_num_bits_per_copy_ld_global()),
+            invariant=False,
+        )
+        rT = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X, self._ROWS_IN_FLIGHT), DTYPE)
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self._ROWS_IN_FLIGHT):
+            if cutlass.const_expr(TAILS):
+                rT[None, t].fill(0)
+                row_pred = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
+                    cute.make_layout((ELEMENTS_X, (1,)), stride=(0, (0,))), Boolean
+                )
+                row_pred[0] = first_row + t < rows_left
+                cute.copy(
+                    load_atom,
+                    gT_thread[(None, first_row + t),],
+                    rT[None, t],
+                    pred=row_pred,
+                    cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                )
+            else:
+                cute.copy(
+                    load_atom,
+                    gT_thread[(None, first_row + t),],
+                    rT[None, t],
+                    cache_policy=cache_policy,
+                )
+        return rT
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _gated_row(
+        self,
+        rAct_row: cute.Tensor,
+        rGate_row: cute.Tensor,
+        rGrad_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        rX0_row: cute.Tensor,
+        rX1_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        limit: Optional[Float32],
+        alpha: Optional[Float32],
+        glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],
+        beta1: Optional[Float32],
+        beta2: Optional[Float32],
+    ):
+        """The gated op of one row of the thread's values, a BF16 pair at a time."""
+        IS_BWD = self.cfg.IS_BWD
+        rA_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rAct_row, Int32)
+        rG_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rGate_row, Int32)
+        rX0_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rX0_row, Int32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+            rD_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rGrad_row, Int32)
+            rX1_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(rX1_row, Int32)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD // 2):
+            grad_lo = grad_hi = None
+            if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+                grad_lo = x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(rD_i32[i])
+                grad_hi = x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(rD_i32[i])
+            out_lo, gate_out_lo = _gated_element(
+                x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(rA_i32[i]),
+                x2_lo_to_f32_bf16(rG_i32[i]),
+                grad_lo,
+                limit,
+                alpha,
+                glu_linear_offset,
+                beta1,
+                beta2,
+                ACTIVATION=self.cfg.GATED_ACTIVATION,
+                IS_BWD=IS_BWD,
+            )
+            out_hi, gate_out_hi = _gated_element(
+                x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(rA_i32[i]),
+                x2_hi_to_f32_bf16(rG_i32[i]),
+                grad_hi,
+                limit,
+                alpha,
+                glu_linear_offset,
+                beta1,
+                beta2,
+                ACTIVATION=self.cfg.GATED_ACTIVATION,
+                IS_BWD=IS_BWD,
+            )
+            rX0_i32[i] = cvt_f32x2_to_bf16x2(out_lo, out_hi)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+                rX1_i32[i] = cvt_f32x2_to_bf16x2(gate_out_lo, gate_out_hi)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _gated_row_tile(
+        self,
+        mAct: cute.Tensor,
+        mGate: cute.Tensor,
+        mGrad: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_row0: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row0: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col0: cute.Tensor,
+        mS_col0: cute.Tensor,
+        mO_row1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_row1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mO_col1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mS_col1: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        limit: Optional[Float32],
+        alpha: Optional[Float32],
+        glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],
+        beta1: Optional[Float32],
+        beta2: Optional[Float32],
+        row_tile: Int32,
+        cta_col: Int32,
+        cache_policy: Int64,
+        TAILS: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    ):
+        """Load one band's inputs, compute the gated op in registers and quantize its parts."""
+        IS_BWD = self.cfg.IS_BWD
+        DTYPE = self.cfg.DTYPE
+        ELEMENTS_Y = self._ELEMENTS_Y_PER_THREAD
+        ELEMENTS_X = self._ELEMENTS_X_PER_THREAD
+        TILE_ROWS = self._CTA_THREADS_Y * ELEMENTS_Y
+        TILE_COLS = self._CTA_THREADS_X * ELEMENTS_X
+        TILER = (TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS)
+        tv_layout = thread_tile_layout(
+            self._CTA_THREADS_Y, self._CTA_THREADS_X, ELEMENTS_Y, ELEMENTS_X
+        )
+
+        # With TAILS every band is predicated: rows and columns past the tensor load as zeros,
+        # which every gated op maps to zero, and are not stored.
+        rows_left = Int32(ELEMENTS_Y)
+        cols_ok = Boolean(True)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(TAILS):
+            rows_left, cols_ok = thread_tile_bounds(
+                TILER,
+                tv_layout,
+                mAct.shape[0] - row_tile * TILE_ROWS,
+                mAct.shape[1] - cta_col * TILE_COLS,
+            )
+
+        gAct = self._thread_view(mAct, row_tile, cta_col)
+        gGate = self._thread_view(mGate, row_tile, cta_col)
+        gGrad = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+            gGrad = self._thread_view(mGrad, row_tile, cta_col)
+
+        # The gated op in FP32, rounded to BF16 as gated_mxfp8.cuh does before taking amaxes:
+        # rX0 is the forward output or the act half's gradient, rX1 the gate half's gradient.
+        # Inputs are loaded _ROWS_IN_FLIGHT rows at a time, as in gated_bidim.cuh, which keeps
+        # fewer of them live.
+        rX0 = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X, ELEMENTS_Y), DTYPE)
+        rX1 = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+            rX1 = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ELEMENTS_X, ELEMENTS_Y), DTYPE)
+        for first_row in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, ELEMENTS_Y, self._ROWS_IN_FLIGHT):
+            rAct = self._load_rows(gAct, first_row, rows_left, cache_policy, TAILS=TAILS)
+            rGate = self._load_rows(gGate, first_row, rows_left, cache_policy, TAILS=TAILS)
+            rGrad = None
+            if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+                rGrad = self._load_rows(gGrad, first_row, rows_left, cache_policy, TAILS=TAILS)
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self._ROWS_IN_FLIGHT):
+                rGrad_row = rX1_row = None
+                if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+                    rGrad_row = rGrad[None, t]
+                    rX1_row = rX1[None, first_row + t]
+                self._gated_row(
+                    rAct[None, t],
+                    rGate[None, t],
+                    rGrad_row,
+                    rX0[None, first_row + t],
+                    rX1_row,
+                    limit,
+                    alpha,
+                    glu_linear_offset,
+                    beta1,
+                    beta2,
+                )
+
+        self._quantize_part(
+            rX0,
+            mO_row0,
+            mS_row0,
+            mO_col0,
+            mS_col0,
+            row_tile,

+"""Gated-activation MXFP8 casts in CuTeDSL, ported from gated_mxfp8.cuh.
+
+The kernel reuses MXFP8QuantizeGeneralG2SKernel's TMA pipeline and its plain-cast SMEM tile
+quantizer. What it adds is an elementwise pass that runs on each staged tile before it is
+quantized: it combines the act and gate halves of the input (and the incoming gradient, in
+backward) and writes the result back into the act (and gate) input buffer in the input dtype.
+That is exactly the truncation the CUDA kernel applies before computing block amaxes, so the
+plain cast that follows reproduces its output.
+
+Gated input is [M, 2N] with [act | gate] along the last dim. Every operand is addressed through
+(M, N) views (stride 2N, column offset 0 or N), mirroring the CUDA kernel's tensor maps:
+  forward : out[M, N] = act(x[:, :N]) * gate(x[:, N:])
+  backward: out[M, 2N] = [d/d act | d/d gate] given grad[M, N]
+"""

+@cute.jit
+def _select_f32(pred: Boolean, if_true: Float32, if_false: Float32) -> Float32:
+    result = if_false
+    if pred:
+        result = if_true
+    return result
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _gated_element(
+    act_elt: Float32,
+    gate_elt: Float32,
+    grad_elt: Optional[Float32],
+    limit: Optional[Float32],
+    alpha: Optional[Float32],
+    glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],
+    beta1: Optional[Float32],
+    beta2: Optional[Float32],
+    ACTIVATION: cutlass.Constexpr[str],
+    IS_BWD: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    """One element of the gated op in FP32; returns (act output, gate output or None).
+
+    Mirrors the elementwise math of gated_mxfp8.cuh's columnwise pass (forward and backward),
+    operation by operation.
+    """
+    out_gate = None
+    # Transform the gate. Gating is ideally the identity, with derivative 1.
+    gate = gate_elt
+    dgate = None
+    if cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "clamped_swiglu"):
+        # |g| > limit is gated_mxfp8.cuh's (g > limit || g < -limit), NaN included
+        dgate = _select_f32(fabs_f32(gate_elt) > limit, Float32(0.0), Float32(1.0))
+        gate = cute.arch.fmin(cute.arch.fmax(-limit, gate_elt), limit) + glu_linear_offset
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "situglu"):
+        dgate = dsitu_up(gate_elt, beta2)
+        gate = situ_up(gate_elt, beta2)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not IS_BWD):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "clamped_swiglu"):
+            act = act_clamped_silu(act_elt, limit, alpha)
+        elif cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "situglu"):
+            act = act_situ_gate(act_elt, beta1)
+        else:
+            act = GATED_ACTIVATIONS[ACTIVATION][0](act_elt)
+        out_act = act * gate
+    else:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "clamped_swiglu"):
+            x = cute.arch.fmin(act_elt, limit)
+            s = sigmoidf(alpha * x)
+            act_x = x * s
+            dact_x = _select_f32(
+                act_elt <= limit, s + s * (Float32(1.0) - s) * alpha * x, Float32(0.0)
+            )
+        elif cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "situglu"):
+            act_x = act_situ_gate(act_elt, beta1)
+            dact_x = dact_dsitu_gate(act_elt, beta1)
+        elif cutlass.const_expr(ACTIVATION == "swiglu"):
+            s = sigmoidf(act_elt)
+            act_x = act_elt * s
+            dact_x = act_elt * s * (Float32(1.0) - s) + s
+        else:
+            act_fn, dact_fn = GATED_ACTIVATIONS[ACTIVATION]
+            act_x = act_fn(act_elt)
+            dact_x = dact_fn(act_elt)
+        out_act = dact_x * grad_elt * gate
+        if cutlass.const_expr(dgate is None):
+            out_gate = act_x * grad_elt
+        else:
+            out_gate = dgate * act_x * grad_elt
+    return out_act, out_gate
+

+@cute.jit
+def gated_elementwise_smem_tile(
+    sAct_tile: cute.Tensor,
+    sGate_tile: cute.Tensor,
+    sGrad_tile: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    limit: Optional[Float32],
+    alpha: Optional[Float32],
+    glu_linear_offset: Optional[Float32],
+    beta1: Optional[Float32],
+    beta2: Optional[Float32],
+    ACTIVATION: cutlass.Constexpr[str],
+    IS_BWD: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    DTYPE: cutlass.Constexpr[type],
+    TILE_X: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """Compute the gated op on one staged tile, in place, rounded to the input dtype.
+
+    Thread tidx owns column tidx of the tile, which is also the element set it owns in the
+    colwise quantization pass, so a colwise-only consumer needs no barrier after this.
+    """
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+
+    _, tv_layout = cute.make_layout_tv(
+        thr_layout=cute.make_layout((1, TILE_X), stride=(TILE_X, 1)),
+        val_layout=cute.make_layout((MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE, 1), stride=(1, 1)),
+    )
+    sAct_thread = cute.composition(sAct_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+    sGate_thread = cute.composition(sGate_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+    if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+        sGrad_thread = cute.composition(sGrad_tile, tv_layout)[tidx, None]
+    if cutlass.const_expr(is_packed16(DTYPE)):
+        truncate_f32 = truncate_f32_f16 if DTYPE is cutlass.Float16 else truncate_f32_bf16
+
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE):
+        grad_elt = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+            grad_elt = Float32(sGrad_thread[i])
+        out_act, out_gate = _gated_element(
+            Float32(sAct_thread[i]),
+            Float32(sGate_thread[i]),
+            grad_elt,
+            limit,
+            alpha,
+            glu_linear_offset,
+            beta1,
+            beta2,
+            ACTIVATION=ACTIVATION,
+            IS_BWD=IS_BWD,
+        )
+        # Numerical truncation: round to the input dtype, like the CUDA kernels do before
+        # taking the amax. The cast below is then exact.
+        if cutlass.const_expr(is_packed16(DTYPE)):
+            out_act = truncate_f32(out_act)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+                out_gate = truncate_f32(out_gate)
+        sAct_thread[i] = DTYPE(out_act)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(IS_BWD):
+            sGate_thread[i] = DTYPE(out_gate)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _split_gated_scales(
+    mS_row: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mS_col: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    M: Int32,
+    N: Int32,
+    ROWWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    COLWISE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    SWIZZLED: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    """Act and gate views of the backward output's scales; returns
+    (act_row, gate_row, act_col, gate_col).
+
+    The [M, 2N] output is [d act | d gate] and its scales are laid out for the whole output. Each
+    view has the shape of an [M, N] tensor's scales and the strides of the whole output's, and
+    starts where the whole output's layout places that half's first scale. For swizzled scales
+    this needs the halves to be whole 128x4 tiles (N % 128 == 0, required by the C++ dispatcher).
+    """
+    act_row = gate_row = act_col = gate_col = None
+    if cutlass.const_expr(SWIZZLED):
+        mS_row, mS_col = derive_swizzled_scale_layout(M, 2 * N, ROWWISE, COLWISE, mS_row, mS_col)
+        half_tiles = N // 128
+        if cutlass.const_expr(ROWWISE):
+            row_tiler = (
+                cute.make_layout((32, 4, cute.ceil_div(M, 128))),  # all rows
+                cute.make_layout((4, half_tiles)),  # one half's scale columns
+            )
+            act_row = cute.local_tile(mS_row, row_tiler, (0, 0))
+            gate_row = cute.local_tile(mS_row, row_tiler, (0, 1))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(COLWISE):
+            col_tiler = (
+                cute.make_layout((4, cute.ceil_div(cute.ceil_div(M, 32), 4))),  # all scale rows
+                cute.make_layout((32, 4, half_tiles)),  # one half's columns
+            )
+            act_col = cute.local_tile(mS_col, col_tiler, (0, 0))
+            gate_col = cute.local_tile(mS_col, col_tiler, (0, 1))
+    else:
+        # Compact scales are row-major, so each half is a block of scale columns
+        if cutlass.const_expr(ROWWISE):
+            row_tiler = (mS_row.shape[0], N // MXFP8_BLOCK_SCALING_SIZE)
+            act_row = cute.local_tile(mS_row, row_tiler, (0, 0))
+            gate_row = cute.local_tile(mS_row, row_tiler, (0, 1))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(COLWISE):
+            col_tiler = (mS_col.shape[0], N)
+            act_col = cute.local_tile(mS_col, col_tiler, (0, 0))
+            gate_col = cute.local_tile(mS_col, col_tiler, (0, 1))
+    return act_row, gate_row, act_col, gate_col

+        mS_row_dact = mS_row_dgate = mS_col_dact = mS_col_dgate = None  # BWD only
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.cfg.IS_BWD):

+    @cute.jit

+        mO_row_dact: Optional[cute.Tensor],  # BWD only
+        mO_row_dgate: Optional[cute.Tensor],  # BWD only

+  kQGeGLU,
+  kReGLU,
+  kSReGLU,
+  kSwiGLU,
+  kGLU,

+  kUnsupported,
+  kNumTypes
+};

+inline const char *gated_activation_to_str(GatedActivation act) {
+  switch (act) {
+    case GatedActivation::kGeGLU:
+      return "geglu";
+    case GatedActivation::kQGeGLU:
+      return "qgeglu";
+    case GatedActivation::kReGLU:
+      return "reglu";
+    case GatedActivation::kSReGLU:

+      return "swiglu";
+    case GatedActivation::kGLU:

+    case GatedActivation::kClampedSwiGLU:
+      return "clamped_swiglu";

+    case GatedActivation::kNumTypes:

issue_comments.body: This cannot be merged until #3642 and #3766 are merged and this is rebased upon

the gated kernels with LUT and register-resident approach is also added in this PR in CUDA,. However I would like to move it to CuteDSL. However, @kainzhong  is already working on it, so this draft will temporarily have the CUDA version, but will rebase don kaining's CuteDSL version of the gated kernel to add the LUT once that PR is up. This will make this PR also waiting for that.

If not, I will drop support for LUT in gateed kernel entirely in this PR and make that a follow up PR
